scope: Documented international financing and institutional links to qualifying Caribbean climate, transition, resilience and environmental mechanisms.
inclusionCriteria: Document an identifiable Caribbean operation or funded delivery relationship using primary evidence.
Record each legal institution and financing mechanism under a stable reusable ID.
Record a general eligibility, strategy or fundraising statement as a research lead.
Treat institution-wide capital separately from a mechanism-specific funding allocation.
Give direct financing, grants, administration, approval, advisory and risk support distinct claims.
Preserve source currency, financial stage, reporting date precision and source-level ambiguity.
integrationNotes: This file is outside src/data and is not imported by the application.
All entities and new assertions require publication approval and final record mapping.
Existing registry relationships and canonical amounts are referenced without duplication.
Research-context actors include brands, investor classes and case operations. These need individual review before registry promotion.
Null reportedOn means the source gives no financial reporting date. observedOn is an access snapshot. Publication will require explicit unknown-date support or further dated evidence.
Source publication dates are nullable and can have month precision. Existing Evidence publishedOn validation requires a full date, so unavailable dates must remain omitted on conversion.
Carbon-market proceeds are a proposed capital-source category to add only if the Adaptation Fund upstream context is approved.
Country coverage names the Caribbean subset for wider regional programmes. The structured wider-region financial totals remain unallocated to this subset.
Three mechanisms already researched in the baseline are included only as a separate publication-review item.
